en: Sepia-toned studio portrait of a young woman in three-quarter profile, looking over her shoulder toward the camera. She has carefully waved hair in a 1920s–1930s style and wears an ornate dress or shawl decorated with circular, spiral-like patterns. The background is a plain studio backdrop. In the lower right corner there is an embossed photographer's stamp indicating the studio and city.
